concerns.text: Task T021 (Shear Band Aggregation) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T017 (US1 Output). T017 produces `precursor_metrics.csv` which T021 consumes. A task consuming an artifact from a different user story cannot be parallel-safe relative to that story's completion. The [P] tag is semantically incorrect here.
Task T022 (KS-Test) is marked [P] but depends on T021 (Aggregation). T021 produces the aggregated data required for the test. T022 cannot run in parallel with T021. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T024a (Multiple Test Detection) is marked [P] but depends on T022 (KS-Test results). It must read the output of T022 to count tests. It cannot be parallel-safe relative to T022.
Task T024 (Bonferroni Correction) is marked [P] but depends on T024a and T022. It requires the boolean flag from T024a and the p-values from T022. It cannot be parallel-safe.

Task T029 (Threshold Sweep) is marked [P] but depends on T028a (Derived Threshold). T028a outputs the specific `threshold_value` required for the sweep range. T029 cannot run until T028a completes. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T030 (FPR/FNR Calculation) is marked [P] but depends on T029 (Sweep Results). It must consume the `sensitivity_table.csv` or intermediate data from T029. It cannot be parallel-safe.

Tasks T032b and T033b are marked [P] but the 'Notes' section explicitly states they depend strictly on T035 completion. T035 is the execution step that generates the metrics. T032b/T033b are post-processing steps that read T035's output. They cannot be parallel-safe relative to T035.

Task T045 (Checksum Validation) is marked [P] but depends on T001 (Schema Creation) and T043 (Data Fetch). T045 reads the `expected_sha256` field from the schema created in T001. If T001 is not complete, T045 has no source of truth. While T045 might be parallel to T044, it is not parallel to the foundational setup T001. The [P] tag is misleading without explicit dependency on T001.
